page_title: SaneSales - Bring Sanity to your Sales Tracking

summary.name: SaneSales
summary.one_liner: A free, open-source, privacy-focused sales tracker that shows revenue from Lemon Squeezy, Gumroad, and Stripe across Mac, iPhone, iPad, and Apple Watch.
use_cases: track daily revenue across Lemon Squeezy, Gumroad and Stripe
see today's sales from the macOS menu bar
export order history for accounting or tax prep
monitor sales from an iPhone or Apple Watch
replace a spreadsheet for multi-platform sales totals
summary.what_it_does: SaneSales connects to Lemon Squeezy, Gumroad, and Stripe using API keys that the user generates, and fetches orders, products, and revenue directly from each provider to the user's device. It shows today's revenue compared with yesterday, 7-day, 30-day, and custom date ranges, plus daily revenue charts and a donut chart of revenue by product. Users can search and filter full order history by customer, product, amount, provider, status, or date, and export orders as CSV. Sales data is cached locally after the first sync so it can be viewed offline.
notable: Connects directly to each provider from the device; SaneApps does not receive sales data
macOS menu bar and Home Screen/lock screen widgets show today's revenue
MIT licensed with all features unlocked and no subscription
Compared against Baremetrics and ChartMogul, which are browser-based
caveats: Only read-access API keys are needed, but users must create and manage keys in each provider's settings
MRR/ARR metrics are on the roadmap and not yet available; subscription renewals appear only as individual orders
Donations are optional; the page lists Free* with an asterisk and no paid tier is described beyond the donate option
